title: Morpho Blue wSPYx/AUSD — MorphoPythOracle x donation-inflatable ERC-4626

LLTV=0.86 => borrowing against own collateral loses 16.3% of the borrowed amount unless the oracle over-values the collateral, which the donation cannot achieve profitably
Market free liquidity is only $1,306.99, the hard cap on any single-market extraction

caveats: Point-in-time 2026-10-25; re-read live state before acting

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Morpho wSPYx/AUSD; the Pyth x donation-inflatable ERC-4626 oracle primitive is real and fork-proven but economically closed (donation costs more than it yields; borrow-and-default loses the 86% LLTV haircut) and the hard cap is the $1,306.99 free liquidity.
